serial.title: Serial port
serial.description: Select the port your Meshtastic radio is connected to. Connecting can take up to a minute while the radio sends its node database.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the radio. Check the port and that no other program uses it.
error.timeout: The radio did not finish sending its configuration in time.
error.no_response: The port opened, but nothing answered like a Meshtastic radio. This is probably not the radio (for example /dev/ttyAMA10 is the Raspberry Pi's built-in debug UART), or the radio's serial API is disabled.
error.no_usb_ports: No USB serial device was detected. Ports like /dev/ttyAMA… belong to the board itself, not the radio. Check that the radio is on and the USB cable carries data (not charge-only), then reopen this dialog.

send_text.name: Send text message
send_text.description: Sends a text message over the mesh.

config_entry_id.name: Radio
config_entry_id.description: Radio to send from (required when more than one is configured).

to.name: To
to.description: Node id like !a1b2c3d4. Leave empty to broadcast on the channel.

channel_name.name: Channel name
channel_name.description: Send on the channel with this name instead of an index.

add_channel.name: Add channel
add_channel.description: Creates a secondary channel in the first free slot. Share it from the Meshtastic panel (QR code) so other radios can join.

config_entry_id.name: Radio
config_entry_id.description: Radio to configure (required when more than one is configured).

name.name: Name
name.description: Channel name, up to 11 bytes (Polish letters take 2).

key.name: Encryption key
key.description: Random 256-bit key (private), the public default key, none, or your own key.

psk.name: Own key
psk.description: Base64 key of 16 or 32 bytes, used when the key is set to own key.

position_precision.name: Position precision
position_precision.description: 0 = never share position on this channel, 32 = precise, 13 = about 2.9 km.

muted.name: Muted
muted.description: Do not notify on the radio for this channel.

delete_channel.name: Delete channel
delete_channel.description: Deletes a secondary channel by name or index. Later channels move up one slot.

config_entry_id.name: Radio
config_entry_id.description: Radio to configure (required when more than one is configured).

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the channel to delete.

index.name: Index
index.description: Slot 1-7 of the channel to delete (alternative to the name).

join_channel.name: Join channel from link
join_channel.description: Adds the channels from a Meshtastic share link. With replace, all channels and the LoRa settings are replaced and the radio reboots.

config_entry_id.name: Radio
config_entry_id.description: Radio to configure (required when more than one is configured).

url.name: Link
url.description: Channel share link copied from the Meshtastic app (Share channel / QR code).

replace.name: Replace everything
replace.description: Replace all channels and the LoRa settings (radio reboots) instead of adding.

text_too_long.message: The message is longer than 200 bytes.

entry_required.message: Several radios are configured; choose one.
